title: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation Strategies for Large Language Models in Travel Mode Choice Prediction

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates statistical bias in model predictions caused by heavily overrepresented majority classes (e.g., driving vs. transit) in the training data. This is measured by comparing the predictive performance (Accuracy, F1 score, Recall, Precision) of basic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approaches against a "Balanced Retrieval" RAG strategy designed to sample an equal number of examples from every travel mode category.
